run_align_outputs_with_paragraphs: run the paragraph alignment tool to align machine summaries with source document paragraphs using sentence embeddings
run_monotonic_align: run monotonic alignment on a similarity matrix to find the optimal sentence-to-sentence alignment path with skips
run_bipartite_split: run bipartite splitting on sentence similarities and alignment to produce aligned source and target segments
run_match_text_pairs: run text pair matching to find the most similar text on the right for each text on the left using n-gram bags
run_convert_multisentence_segments: run conversion of sentence-level segment IDs into actual text segments preserving original separators and whitespace
